name: Sun Pharma Advanced Research Company Ltd

documents.title: Filing Of Application For Reclassification With Stock Exchanges
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter Ended June 30, 2026

analysis.summary: Sun Pharma Advanced Research Company Ltd (SPARC) held its R&D Day conference call to provide updates on its prioritized clinical and preclinical programs, cost optimization measures, and funding plans. Management highlighted progress on its two key clinical assets, SCD-153 (topical itaconate analogue for alopecia areata and vitiligo) and SBO-154 (MUC1-targeted ADC for solid tumors). Additionally, the company discussed portfolio restructuring around oncology and immunology, a potential NewCo structure for SCO-155, legal updates regarding the pediatric rare diseases voucher (PRV), and efforts to extend its cash window through FY28. Sun Pharma Advanced Research Company Ltd submitted an investor presentation letter to the National Stock Exchange of India Ltd and BSE Limited on January 08, 2026. The letter provided details for an investor conference call scheduled for January 08, 2026, at 4:00 PM (IST) along with audio dial-in numbers and a web link.

guidance.claim: SPARC expects to complete enrollment in all cohorts of the SCD-153 Phase 1B study in the third quarter of 2026.
guidance.quote: In terms of the key milestones, the enrollment in all cohorts of the study is targeted to be completed in the quarter 3 of the year 2026.

guidance.claim: SPARC expects top-line results for the SCD-153 Phase 1B study in the fourth quarter of 2026.
guidance.quote: Top line results are expected in Q4, and we plan to initiate a global Phase 2 clinical study in the quarter 2 of the calendar year 2027.

guidance.claim: SPARC expects to complete dosing to the highest dose cohort of 2.4 milligrams per kilogram for SBO-154 by the end of the third quarter of this year.
guidance.quote: We expect to complete dosing to the highest dose cohort of 2.4 milligrams per kilogram by the end of the third quarter of this year.

guidance.claim: SPARC expects to have the maximum tolerated dose identified for SBO-154 by the end of the third quarter of 2026.
guidance.quote: We expect, as I mentioned, to expect to have the maximum tolerated dose, or the MTD, identified by the end of the third quarter of 2026, allowing us to proceed with cohort expansion by the end of the calendar year, and a potential early clinical proof of concept by the second half of 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: SPARC plans to initiate a global Phase 2 clinical study for SCD-153 in the second quarter of the calendar year 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: Top line results are expected in Q4, and we plan to initiate a global Phase 2 clinical study in the quarter 2 of the calendar year 2027.

margins_costs.claim: Overall operational costs are expected to increase only marginally, going from 31 million last year to 29 million this year.
margins_costs.quote: From 31 million last year, we are projected to go down to 29 million this year, even though we plan to scale our clinical program significantly. Our overall ops cost is expected to only increase marginally.

capital_allocation.claim: SPARC has been funding its early development using promoter-backed debt that is cumulatively over 45 million as of Q2 FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Plus we've been funding our early development using promoter-backed debt, which is cumulatively 45 million-plus now as of Q2 FY '26.

capital_allocation.claim: SPARC is finalizing a funding plan to extend its cash window to FY28 and complete it in the first half of this calendar year.
capital_allocation.quote: We need now a significant additional resources to deliver the outcomes discussed in this presentation and we are in the process of finalizing a funding plan to extend the cash window to FY '28 and hope to complete that process in the first half of this calendar year.

risks_headwinds.claim: SPARC noted that the original NDA for PDP-716 received a complete response letter driven by the OAI status of the third-party API vendor.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our original NDA received a complete response letter, driven by the OAI status of the third-party API vendor.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that licensing interest from large pharmaceutical companies for vodobatinib has been limited due to perceived market-size limitations.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, the licensing interest from large pharmaceutical companies has been limited, largely on account of perceived market-size limitations, even with Asciminib’s commercial success and the rising industry interest in the next-generation TKI companies.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that Vodobatinib challenges were multi-factorial, including the reliability of animal models and viability of appropriate clinical trial designs.
risks_headwinds.quote: While our challenges with Vodobatinib were truly multi-factorial, couple of key ones stood out on reflection. Reliability of animal models and viability of appropriate clinical trial designs in terms of duration of the study, number of patients, availability of reliable biomarkers, etc.

management_commitments.claim: SPARC expects to have safety and preliminary efficacy data for SCD-153 by the fourth quarter of this calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: And this is an early signal seeking study and we expect to have safety and preliminary efficacy data by the fourth quarter of this calendar year and transition the program to a, hopefully to a larger Phase 2 trial thereafter.

management_commitments.claim: SPARC expects to receive a pediatric rare diseases voucher subject to a possible appeal expiring by the end of January.
management_commitments.quote: This judgment comes with a two-month appeal window that is now, you know, getting to that expiry of that appeal window by end of Jan. Subject to a possible appeal, SPARC expects to receive a voucher, which can lead to a meaningful encashment.

management_commitments.claim: SPARC plans to complete its funding plan process to extend the cash window to FY28 in the first half of this calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: We need now a significant additional resources to deliver the outcomes discussed in this presentation and we are in the process of finalizing a funding plan to extend the cash window to FY '28 and hope to complete that process in the first half of this calendar year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the court's initial opinion on the Sezaby pediatric rare diseases voucher matter in the last quarter of the financial year.
management_commitments.quote: After exhausting all available reasonable options, we have approached the court for direction in February 2024 and we expect the courts initial opinion on this matter in the last quarter of this financial year.
management_commitments.timeframe: last quarter of this financial year

management_commitments.claim: Management is working with the current management of Ocuvex to complete the CRL response by the second quarter of the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We are working very closely with the current management of Ocuvex, that’s their new name, to complete the CRL response by 2nd quarter of the next financial year and ensuring a successful launch once we get the approval which we hope to get before the turn of FY26.
management_commitments.timeframe: 2nd quarter of the next financial year

management_commitments.claim: Atopic dermatitis 16-week topline for Vibozilimod is expected in Q4 of FY25.
management_commitments.quote: Atopic dermatitis 16 week topline is expected in Q4 of FY25, while Psoriasis is expected to reach topline readout in Q1, FY26.

management_commitments.claim: The Phase IB study of SCD-153 in Alopecia Areata patients will be initiated in the Q1 of FY26.
management_commitments.quote: The Phase IB study in Alopecia Areata patients will be initiated in the Q1 of FY26.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets to initiate a global Phase IIB study for SCD-153 in Q4 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We will get interim readout from this study in Q1 of FY27 and we target to initiate a global Phase IIB study in Q4 of FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
